note: Every source COP shows, with its licence and whether a paid COP could use it (Tom, 31 Oct 2026: a paid tier is possible later). commercial_ok is true, false or unknown; basis says why. The free public picture uses everything; the flag drives nothing yet. snapshot.py lists any source id seen in a feed but missing here as unregistered, so a new upstream (for example a non-commercial one) can't slip into a paid tier unnoticed. Tom reviews every value before anyone pays.

noisefloor-feed.name: Noisefloor
noisefloor-feed.licence: ODbL 1.0 for derived data; text CC BY 4.0
noisefloor-feed.basis: Tom's own program; ODbL allows commercial use with attribution and share-alike on derived databases.

gdelt-events.name: The GDELT Project (Events)
gdelt-events.licence: GDELT terms: free for any use with a citation and a link

gdelt-gkg.name: The GDELT Project (GKG)
gdelt-gkg.licence: GDELT terms: free for any use with a citation and a link

adsblol-archive.basis: ODbL 1.0 allows commercial use with attribution and share-alike.

ransomlook.name: RansomLook
ransomlook.basis: CC BY 4.0 allows commercial use with attribution.

first-epss.name: FIRST EPSS

elements-feed.name: Elements

cordon-feed.name: Cordon
cordon-feed.licence: Cordon code MIT; content per source

copernicus-ems.name: Copernicus Emergency Management Service (European Union)
copernicus-ems.licence: Copernicus: free and open, with attribution (© European Union)
copernicus-ems.basis: Copernicus data policy: free, full and open access for any use, with attribution; recheck the EMS product terms before a sale.

state-travel-advisories.name: US Department of State travel advisories
state-travel-advisories.licence: US public domain (seals and logos restricted)
state-travel-advisories.basis: US federal government work; don't reuse the seal or logos.

nga-navwarnings.name: US National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency navigational warnings

easa-czib.name: EASA conflict zone information bulletins
easa-czib.basis: EASA allows reuse with acknowledgement; commercial reuse not confirmed.

open-meteo-gefs.name: NOAA GEFS ensemble via Open-Meteo (Vis)
open-meteo-gefs.licence: CC BY 4.0 (Open-Meteo); NOAA NCEP public domain
open-meteo-gefs.basis: Open-Meteo's free API is for non-commercial use only (open-meteo.com/en/terms, read 31 Oct 2026); commercial use needs its paid API. The GEFS data itself is US public domain.

open-meteo-ecmwf.name: ECMWF IFS ensemble via Open-Meteo (Vis)
open-meteo-ecmwf.licence: CC BY 4.0 (Open-Meteo and ECMWF open data)
open-meteo-ecmwf.basis: Open-Meteo's free API is for non-commercial use only (open-meteo.com/en/terms, read 31 Oct 2026); commercial use needs its paid API. ECMWF open data is CC BY 4.0, which allows commercial use with credit.

astro-meeus.name: Sun and moon computed by Vis (Meeus)
astro-meeus.basis: Tom's own program; computed from published formulas, no outside data.

ioda-gatech.name: Georgia Tech IODA (Internet Outage Detection and Analysis), via Blackout
ioda-gatech.basis: IODA's API page and site state no data licence or terms (checked 12 Nov 2026); Blackout's feed credits IODA and claims no licence for it (corrected 12 Nov 2026). Ask Georgia Tech's IODA team before a sale.

ooni-api.name: OONI (Open Observatory of Network Interference) measurements, via Blackout
ooni-api.basis: The OONI Data License applies to all published OONI data and is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (github.com/ooni/license, data/LICENSE.md, read 12 Nov 2026): non-commercial only. Blackout's feed states this licence (corrected 12 Nov 2026).

telegeography-cables.name: Blackout's submarine cable corridor register (hand-compiled)
telegeography-cables.licence: Blackout's own register; no TeleGeography data ingested
telegeography-cables.basis: Tom's own list of cable names and landing countries, checked against TeleGeography's public map. Confirm nothing was copied from the map before a sale.

aws-health.name: AWS Health Dashboard status feed, via Blackout
aws-health.licence: No licence stated; facts and link only
aws-health.basis: AWS's status feed carries no licence, as Blackout records it; Blackout carries the incident title, times, affected areas and a link, not the text. Check the provider's site terms before a sale.

gcp-status.name: Google Cloud Service Health incidents, via Blackout
gcp-status.licence: No licence stated; facts and link only
gcp-status.basis: Google Cloud's status feed carries no licence, as Blackout records it; Blackout carries the incident title, times, affected areas and a link, not the text. Check the provider's site terms before a sale.

azure-status.name: Azure status feed, via Blackout
azure-status.licence: No licence stated; facts and link only
azure-status.basis: Microsoft's status feed carries no licence, as Blackout records it; Blackout carries the incident title, times, affected areas and a link, not the text. Check the provider's site terms before a sale.

starlink-statuspage.name: starlink.statuspage.io (operator unverified), via Blackout
starlink-statuspage.licence: No licence stated; facts and link only
starlink-statuspage.basis: The page's operator is unverified; its status feed carries no licence, as Blackout records it; Blackout carries the incident title, times, affected areas and a link, not the text. Check the provider's site terms before a sale.

m365-status.name: Microsoft 365 public service status (status.cloud.microsoft), via Blackout
m365-status.licence: No licence stated; facts and link only
m365-status.basis: Microsoft's public status page carries no licence, as Blackout records it; Blackout carries the post title, status, affected services, update time and a link. It shows only the issues Microsoft posts publicly. Check the provider's site terms before a sale.

cloudflare-status.name: Cloudflare Status unresolved incidents, via Blackout
cloudflare-status.licence: No licence stated; facts and link only
cloudflare-status.basis: Cloudflare's status feed carries no licence, as Blackout records it; Blackout keeps only network, CDN, DNS (incl. 1.1.1.1), WARP and data-centre incidents, or those rated major or critical, and carries the name, status, impact, components, times and a link. Check the provider's site terms before a sale.

gworkspace-status.name: Google Workspace Status Dashboard incidents, via Blackout
gworkspace-status.licence: No licence stated; facts and link only
gworkspace-status.basis: Google Workspace's status feed carries no licence, as Blackout records it; Blackout carries the incident title, products, times and a link. Check the provider's site terms before a sale.

apple-status.name: Apple System Status (consumer services), via Blackout
apple-status.licence: No licence for the status data; facts and link only
apple-status.basis: Apple's website Terms of Use bar republishing site content without Apple's consent (apple.com/legal/internet-services/terms/site.html, as Blackout records it, read 13 Nov 2026); Blackout carries only the affected services, status type and times with a link, never Apple's wording. Likely needs Apple's consent for a paid use; ask or drop before a sale.

akamai-status.name: Akamai Status incident history (RSS), via Blackout
akamai-status.licence: No licence stated; facts and link only
akamai-status.basis: Akamai's status feed carries no licence, as Blackout records it; Blackout reads the RSS because the site's robots.txt disallows /api/, leaves out security advisories, and carries the title, status, times and a link. Check the provider's site terms before a sale.

slack-status.name: Slack Status API (current incidents), via Blackout
slack-status.licence: No licence stated; facts and link only
slack-status.basis: Slack's status API carries no licence, as Blackout records it; Blackout carries the incident title, type, status, affected services, times and a link. Slack is part of Salesforce. Check the provider's site terms before a sale.

zoom-status.name: Zoom status incident history (RSS), via Blackout
zoom-status.licence: No licence stated; facts and link only
zoom-status.basis: Zoom's status feed carries no licence, as Blackout records it; Blackout reads the RSS because the site's robots.txt disallows /api/, and carries the title, status, times and a link. Check the provider's site terms before a sale.

cloudflare-radar.name: Cloudflare Radar outage annotations and verified traffic anomalies, via Blackout
cloudflare-radar.basis: Radar's API data is made available under CC BY-NC 4.0 (developers.cloudflare.com/radar, read 13 Nov 2026): non-commercial only, with attribution. Blackout quotes Cloudflare's outage descriptions and causes.
